g.text: Mean income per day within the richest decile (before tax)
The mean income per day within the richest decile (tenth of the population). This data is adjusted for inflation
and differences in living costs between countries. Income here is measured before taxes and benefits.
Note: This data is expressed in international-$ at 2021 prices. Income has been equivalized.
